entries.515b3bb360196090: Customers for air-conditioning and heat-source equipment and equipment-related businesses
entries.6b068c218f66db42: A manufacturer that makes and sells air conditioning equipment, heat source equipment, and cast products, and also carries out construction and maintenance of air conditioning facilities and similar systems.
entries.9e20aa81fb0c39a6: Manufactures and sells air-conditioning equipment, heat-source equipment and environmental equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,993 million.
entries.e7757aac479772f6: This business manufactures and sells air-conditioning equipment such as fan coil units and air handling units, heat-source equipment such as commercial EcoCute units, boilers, heaters, burners and Oyusis, environmental equipment such as circulating hot-water bath units and air purifiers, and heat-treatment furnaces for manufacturing liquid crystal panels. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,146 million. Consolidated subsidiary Showa Total Service Co., Ltd. leases and manages real estate within the Group.
